skills.title: Air Advantage
skills.description: Can take off within 1 hex of an aircraft carrier. Ignores the effects of any terrain type on Mobility, ignores the effects of any land mines or naval mines, and enemy forces cannot counterattack when attacking. The combat effectiveness will not go down when HP is reduced

skills.title: Evasive Maneuvers
skills.description: When attacked by the land or naval forces, there is 40% probability of dodging the damage.

skills.title: Remote Sensing Strike
skills.description: Increase damage dealt to armored, artillery, and naval units by 20%.

skills.title: Tactical Blast
skills.description: Initiate the self-destruct program, consume all remaining HP to deal damage equal to 30% of the drone’s HP prior to self-destruction to all targets within a one-hex radius, affecting both allies and enemies.

levels.note:
Unlock Air Advantage
Unlock Evasive Maneuvers
Unlock Remote Sensing Strike
Unlock Tactical Blast
